title: HarborDeck answer line
description: One line of <HARBORDECK_HOME>/answers.jsonl, appended by the app per user action. Undo is not an action: an undone line is never written.

id.description: Item id; for action=request a new id minted by the app.

key.description: decide only: the chosen option key.

anchor.description: comment only: what the note points at.

to.description: request only: the agent id (fleet firstmates[].id) the order is handed to.

rule.description: request, comment, needs-work, ask only: the user marked the message "Remember this", a standing order to file with their preferences, not a one-off. Absent otherwise (never false).

attachments.description: Images the user pasted, dropped or snapped (request, comment, ask, needs-work; any action may carry them). The app copies each into <HARBORDECK_HOME>/attachments/<yyyy-mm>/ before writing the line, so the paths stay readable after any temp file is gone.

path.description: Absolute path of the original (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF) under the data directory's attachments/ folder.

marked.description: The same image with the user's marks drawn in (PNG), when there are marks. Prefer it when showing the image.

marks.description: What the user drew, positions normalized 0..1 of the image. Pins and boxes carry a number n; their notes are also appended to the answer note as [n] text ([k.n] for the k-th image).

until.description: defer only: epoch seconds the user wants the item back. The item stays open; the app hides it until then.
